title: The Little Prince – level 2
paragraphs: The Little Prince is a famous book by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. Now, you can listen to the story of the little prince. You can find the book at www.thelittleprinceinlevels.com. The book is in three levels.
You can also send a link to this website to your friends.
We hope that you will enjoy the book. It was first published in 1943. The book became one of the best books in history.
